workItem: Backend-first account security convergence for confirmation-mail password reset, primary-login passkeys, and profile SPA routing.
workItemDE: Backend-first Kontosicherheit für bestätigten Passwort-Reset, Primärlogin-Passkeys und Profil-SPA-Routing.
projectStage: PVC-02 controlled implementation; supporting PVC-08 production operations
priorityReason: Fresh Human Owner direction makes Profile/Security the authenticated account surface and requires productive self-service security methods.
scopeBoundary: No browser-owned Supabase session or bearer token.
No primary passkey is treated as MFA/AAL2.
No direct main mutation or direct provider-secret handling.
No FE ProfilePage/Header mutation in this OPS slice.

evidence.openWriterOverlap: PASS: FE #1371, OPS #1370 and FINTECH #1369 have no changed-file overlap with this backend slice.
evidence.providerDocs: Supabase passkeys use experimental two-step WebAuthn start/verify APIs and require stable RP configuration.

acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated password reset targets only the verified current user e-mail and uses the existing e-mail confirmation route.
Passkey registration and login use backend Supabase start/verify with browser-only WebAuthn public ceremony payloads.
Successful passkey login persists backend HttpOnly session.
Profile and password-update direct routes are included in production SPA fallback.
Provider desired config enables passkeys for capital-ai.online.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession, or abandonment; automation has no merge authority.
